messages:
maria: Incoming pen-test for KV-cache in staging. Assessors want live probing. Propose window 2024-05-10 15:00-17:00 UTC. Need: ephemeral RBAC, KMS export key, S3 evidence flow, and audit snapshots.

tim: +1 on window. Ephemeral role 2h min. Retest owner? I can take verification.

sasha: KMS: create dedicated key for assessor exports, allow kms:GenerateDataKey & kms:Decrypt for assessor role only. Will draft policy.

andre: Ops will create ephemeral role (MaxSessionDuration=7200) and presigned PUT flow. Need assessor principals to lock trust policy. Will validate S3 policy to require x-amz-meta-pt-ticket header.

zoe: Audit: enable CloudTrail data events for S3 & KMS, export to pt-audit-archive with 120d retention. Snapshot at T+15m and close. Evidence naming: pt-789_assessor-<id>_20240510T1500Z.bin with manifest including sha256.

maria: Action items: Sasha -> KMS policy snippet; Andre -> role & presigned runbook; Zoe -> configure audit snapshots; Tim -> retest checklist in JIRA PT-789. Post artifacts here when ready. :thumbsup:
